votes.label: reported
votes.quote: The implementation has a bug in the absolute-path branch: it checks `index <= parts.length - 1`, which is always true for any valid index, so it never actually excludes a marker that's the final segment (unlike the dash-encoded branch, which correctly uses `index < parts.length - 1`). As a result, when the only marker match is the last segment, the code takes an empty tail and returns `""` instead of falling back to the last-two-segments rule.
